### The Infection Is Recorded as Device-Associated but the Enrolment Has No Days of That Device {#sec-problem-details-28}

A sepsis is recorded as associated with a central or peripheral venous catheter, and a pneumonia as associated with invasive or non-invasive ventilation, when the device was in place on the days before the infection.
The surveillance end form of the enrolment counts the days on which each of these devices was in place during the stay, so an enrolment with a device-associated infection has at least one day of that device.
This message appears in the validation report when a sepsis or pneumonia form records a device association but the enrolment's completed surveillance end form counts zero days of that device, or none at all.

Either the device association on the infection form is wrong, or the device days on the surveillance end form are.

Please check both forms (see @sec-solution-15), reopen the one that is wrong for editing (see @sec-solution-9) and correct it: the device association on the sepsis or pneumonia form, or the device days on the surveillance end form.
